tenderSchedule.title: SURVEY DESIGN SUPPLY ERECTION TESTING & COMMISSIONING OF KALAGHATGI TFS FOR FILLING UP OF 107 TANKS LOCATED ON LEFT & RIGHT BANK OF RIVER BY LIFTING WATER FROM BEDTHI RIVER ON TURN-KEY BASIS PHASE 1 WORK CONSISTING OF FOLLOWING COMPONENTS CONSTRUCTION OF JACK WELL CUM PUMP HOUSE VT PUMPS & HT MOTORS, TRANSFORMERS, SUBSTATION, TRANSMISSION LINE RISING MAIN , DISTRIBUTION NETWORK FOR FILLING UP OF 30 TANKS ON LEFT BANK BY MS HDPE PIPES INCLUDING O&M FOR 5 YEARS AFTER COMMISSIONING ON TURNKEY BASIS
tenderSchedule.description: SURVEY INVESTIGATION DESIGN SUPPLY ERECTION TESTING AND COMMISSIONING OF KALAGHATGI TANK FILLING SCHEME FOR FILLING UP OF 107 TANKS LOCATED ON LEFT BANK AND RIGHT BANK OF RIVER BY LIFTING WATER FROM BEDTHI RIVER IN KALAGHATAGI TALUK ON TURN-KEY BASIS PHASE 1 WORK CONSISTING OF FOLLOWING COMPONENTS CONSTRUCTION OF JACK WELL CUM PUMP HOUSE VERTICAL TURBINE PUMPS COUPLED TO HT MOTORS, POWER TRANSFORMERS 33 6.6 KV ELECTRICAL SUBSTATION 33 KV TRANSMISSION LINE AND 33 KV TAPPING POINT RISING MAIN PRESSURE DISTRIBUTION NETWORK FOR FILLING UP OF 30 TANKS ON LEFT BANK THROUGH MS HDPE PIPES WITH INSTALLATION OF SURGE PROTECTION SYSTEM INCLUDING OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE FOR FIVE YEARS AFTER SUCCESSFUL COMMISSIONING OF THE ENTIRE SYSTEM ON TURNKEY BASIS

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer (individual) in his / her name in the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of contract value) as a prime contractor, at least One Lift Irrigation scheme/Tank filling Scheme of value not less than Rs. 26.60 Crores (usually not less than 50% of the amount put to tender under this contract). Work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned Division and Countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the concerned circle is to be uploaded for the technical bid. The cost of completed works of the previous year shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which tender is invited.

The intending bidder in his/its name should have In the last 5 years i.e.,2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved in at least 2 financial years, a minimum financial turnover of Rs.70.94 Crores (usually not less than two times the estimated annual payments under this contract). The financial turnover will be updated to the Present Price Level by giving weight age of 10% each year. Audited Profit and Loss account certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant bearing UDIN along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished.

The intending Bidder should have supplied and successfully commissioned at least 2 numbers of VT pumps with a capacity (flow rate) not less than 0.1216 cumecs for each pump with a head not less than 170.4 m for each pump during the last 5 years in any LIS or Tank filling scheme (i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26). The necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of EE and countersigned by the SE of the same circle should be uploaded.

The intending bidder(Individual) should have supplied, erected, tested, completed and commissioned MS pipes of not less than 300 mm (ID) diameter for a length not less than 29.93 Km, (ii) HDPE pipes of not less than 140 mm (OD) dia for a length of not less than 15.88 Km in any one year during last 5 years (i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26). The necessary work done certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer and countersigned by the Superintending Engineer of the same circle should be uploaded

However, it is obligatory for the contractor to use the following machineries for various activities of roadwork /Irrigation works involved in construction as per MORTH specification and Irrigation manual.
